name: Uenohara (Japan, town)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Uenohara town emblem in orange: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain, above a curved base.
history: Flag of the former town of Uenohara in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-13. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 June 1956.

features.role: Uenohara town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain, above a curved base
